application_order: checkout the recorded CVA6 revision and initialize the HPDcache submodule at the recorded revision
replace rtl/src/common/hpdcache_sync_buffer.sv in the HPDcache submodule with the submitted candidate

run harness/evaluate.sh, which first tests external ports after reset release and then invokes the shared architectural trace evaluator on the native CPU connections without an added test connection patch

reconstruction.reference_hdl: read rtl/src/common/hpdcache_sync_buffer.sv from HPDcache submodule f404e7ebbda8baa4af3729535f520a6b12a06d03, which CVA6 revision 6348e9e684678f83b40d0520028513d06b36e7b2 records
reconstruction.test_sources: git checkout the recorded test revision; no generated test source is stored

port_test.configuration: The data widths of the cv32a60x instances: 4 and 86 bits with FEEDTHROUGH=0, 38 and 86 bits with FEEDTHROUGH=1; 2048 occupied/write/read/payload cases across the four configurations, with each 8-bit payload repeated across the data width. Legal port writes establish occupancy; assert and release reset between clock edges, then check empty state before any subsequent clock edge. Idle edges test retention.
port_test.comparison_scope: Compare permissions and valid data after reset release only; internal signals, invalid data and outputs while reset is asserted are not compared.
port_test.environment: Linux, Python 3, Verilator --binary --timing, C++ and make. VERILATOR may name its executable.
port_test.result: PASS (0) requires 2048 ordered OBS records, SUMMARY configurations=4 cases=2048 errors=0, SYNC_PORT_TEST_COMPLETE and normal exit. The fixed bench builds and runs with the reference module, so a build failure, an abnormal end, a missing or incomplete observation record and an explicit mismatch are FAIL (1). Missing fixed tools or inputs, resource exhaustion and wall-clock timeouts are INVALID (2). Build limit 120 seconds; run limit 10 seconds. CPU evaluation follows only after port-test PASS.
